narrative.overview: Dala's surface is a cinematic, near-monochrome landing rendered almost entirely in pure black. The single load-bearing visual is a generative particle cloud that literalises 'Unlock collective wisdom.' as a constellation of scattered knowledge coalescing. The system is built in negative space: oversized editorial typography on black, generous body prose, and one electric purple doing all the accent work. It explicitly rejects the generic SaaS landing page.
keyCharacteristics: Pure-black canvas (#000000) as the dominant material.
One restrained accent (electric purple #8052ff), used on conversion only.
A single private typeface carrying display, body and UI.
Generative / abstract imagery over literal product screenshots.
Long-scroll, manifesto-paced narrative with motion as reveal.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Electric purple appears on conversion affordances only — never as decoration, divider, or background; under 10% of any viewport.

rules.name: The Scale-Not-Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from dramatic size jumps on a single regular weight, not from bolding.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift off the black; separate with space, not shadows.

dos: Do build on pure black (#000000) and treat blackspace as the primary material.
Do reserve electric purple (#8052ff) for conversion affordances only.
Do drive hierarchy through dramatic type scale on a single regular weight.
Do keep surfaces flat — separate with space, not shadows.
donts: Don't introduce a generic SaaS blue gradient hero or a 3-up feature-card grid.
Don't add stock illustration, light dashboards, or dense multi-card layouts.
Don't spread purple into decoration, dividers, or backgrounds.
Don't lead with feature bullet lists.
Don't add drop shadows or a card elevation ramp.
